name: Ruth Blachford
original_name: ルース・ブラッチフォード
source:
A resourceful American woman who is the representative of one of the world's largest holdings, Philblright. 
She is on a business trip to Japan. At the beginning of the game, Marina is assigned to be her bodyguard.
